datasets.name: UAV orthophotomosaics and digital surface models (DSMs)
datasets.verbatim: Data acquisition has been conducted with a commercial mini-UAV quadrotor platform (Phantom 4 Pro V2.0, DJI, Technology Co., Ltd., Shenzhen, China)... The produced dense point cloud was constructed from 68 million points (2500 points/m2), and the area extent of the scene was approximately 38 ha. From the DSM, different derivatives have been calculated and exploited.

datasets.name: Reference landslide inventory map
datasets.verbatim: Additionally, a reference map was manually created (Figure 1) based on UAV data, Google Earth imagery, previous research in the area [41], and multiple in situ field investigations.

methods.name: Integrated object-based image analysis (OBIA) workflow
methods.summary: An object-based image analysis (OBIA) workflow that uses multi-resolution segmentation (MRS) to create image objects from UAV-derived orthophotos and DSMs, followed by supervised machine learning classification (Random Forest, Decision Tree, or K-Nearest Neighbor) to map landslide zones (scarp, depletion, and non-affected).
methods.source: Authors' own development using eCognition Developer 10 software
methods.verbatim: An integrated object-based image analysis (OBIA) workflow is presented incorporating orthophotomosaics and digital surface models (DSMs) with expert-based and machine learning (ML) algorithms... using Cognition Network programming language (CNL) within the eCognition Developer 10 software [45] (Trimble eCognition, 2020).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and UAV datasets are not linked or made available. The custom OBIA workflow code is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
